what: UE 5.8 readback of the 26 socketed runtime weapon LOD0s: each original kit file against its staged socket-convention re-export (docs/art-direction/WEAPON_SOCKET_EXPORT_PLAN.md)
provenance: W14 from root's reconciled tree (3b0a662d); W18 from Claude's unintegrated rebuild (b0eef326 lineage); the other 23 files are byte-identical in both trees
not_covered: LOD1/LOD2 were not imported (they carry no sockets and were not rewritten); nothing was rendered; no asset was saved; this is not runtime adoption, which root owns

s82.what: diagnosis: control (library convention) and corrected exports from each reloaded blend; nothing gated

s83.what: staging, this tree (claude/photoreal-art at 77e35643): 25 files, 79 sockets, every gate passed

s84.what: staging, root's reconciled W14 (codex/complete-game, kit at 3b0a662d), read-only: 1 file, 4 sockets, every gate passed

s85.what: probe: all 83 corrected sockets pass; wrapper 1 on my whole-array same_import gate (one-step 8-bit flips; W11/W13 one extra render vertex)

s86.what: probe + controls: original vs control bit-identical in UE (25/25); control vs corrected repeats every difference; wrapper 1 on W11/W13 (triangle order)

s87.what: probe + controls + triangle matching: every gate of that version passed, but its tangent angle was blind to a zero tangent (W11)

s88.what: the final probe, with the degenerate-tangent gate and detail: all 83 corrected sockets pass; same_import passes for 25 of 26; W11 fails at 2 corners (a zero tangent in the original import and its control, a valid one in the corrected import)
